He passes through a hallway with tatami mats and sliding doors, guided by a person off-screen. (2) He enters a room filled with colorful Japanese kimonos (yukatas) displayed on racks and shelves. He stands in front of the colorful fabrics, talking and gesturing with his hands. A young woman in a black t-shirt stands beside him. (3) The man and two women have transitioned to wearing colorful kimonos. They stand indoors, laughing, pointing, and celebrating their new looks. One woman has a stylized cartoon face overlay covering her actual face. (4) A different person, dressed in a dark kimono and wearing a face mask, holds a paper scroll and acts out a dramatic character role in front of a sliding door. (5) The group moves outdoors. They are walking along a stone path in a Japanese-style garden area with black wooden houses in the background. One woman holds a traditional pink oil-paper umbrella. (6) A close-up shot focuses on a modern black suitcase being wheeled on the path, creating a humorous contrast with their traditional attire. (7) The three main characters continue walking and laughing through the village, engaging in playful roleplay. The video ends with a black screen containing white text.

(3) Loud cheering and celebratory vocalizations occur as they reveal their kimono outfits. The BGM tempo remains steady, but the vocal energy increases significantly. (4) A comical 'ding' sound effect highlights specific moments of roleplay. The male speaker uses a theatrical, exaggerated tone. (5) Outdoor ambient sounds like birds chirping are briefly audible beneath the music. The voices remain high-energy with frequent laughter.
